summary: Accepted: `coordination-contract-schema` truthfully binds the workflow-root runner's root-scoped work-progression contract and independently evaluates four client-neutral JSON Schema artifacts. It pins each document's exact required/property set and closed-object boundary, round-trips representative fixtures, and exhaustively rejects every missing required field, every top-level field type mutation, every declared const/enum mutation, and unknown properties. It also pins the complete heartbeat/completion/escalation/blocked-question message vocabulary. Missing target schemas currently fail red, so an empty implementation cannot pass; the workflow-root-runner DeveloperTool capability retains separate efficiency and stability coverage.
